up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), and indication details (mesh_heading and efo_term) for all approved drugs indicated for infection. Approved drugs are defined as having max_phase >= 4 in molecule_dictionary. Filter the drug indications to include only those where the mesh_heading or efo_term contains the term 'infection'. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures on molregno. Return distinct results for each drug-indication combination.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase >= 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%infection%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%infection%')
